look_here_first: Look for a low, densely hairy plant with dark maroon-to-brown star-shaped flowers, commonly paired close to the stem and heart-shaped leaves. Then inspect the milkweed gynostegium in the flower center.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: low decumbent or trailing herb, often about 7–40 cm

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems and leaves densely hirsute with long hairs plus minute glandular hairs

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: maroon to dark-brown non-reticulate rotate-campanulate corolla

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: corolla lobes commonly reflexed and hairy on the inner surface

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: five-part ring corona with incurved appendages arching over the anthers

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: central gynostegium conspicuous at close range

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: plant may be noticeably malodorous when handled
